jobs.description_text: CSIT develops products to advance the national security interests of Singapore. We use our products in a wide range of operations, including but not limited to Counter-terrorism and Computer Network Defence. Join the awesome CSIT family and use cutting-edge technologies to protect the nation. We are looking for talented engineer to manage the Data Exploration Platform. This platform helps our users to understand and derive insights from their data. It allows users to explore, visualize, and interact with data in a flexible and intuitive way. Role We are seeking an experienced engineer to join our team, responsible for managing and optimizing our Data Exploration Platform. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the resiliency, stability, security and performance of our platform, as well as providing technical expertise to support the development of data analytics and visualizations solutions. Responsibilities Develop and deploy reliable, scalable and secure Data Exploration Platform solutions Manage the platform, including upgrades, patches, configuration changes, system resource allocation and utilization Optimize the performance of our platform, including troubleshooting and resolving issues related to data processing and query performance Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement changes to optimize the use of our platform. Ensure the security and compliance of our platform, including implementing and enforcing data access controls, authentication and authorization. Provide technical expertise and support to our stakeholders, including training and guidance on the use of our platform. Identify technology and system pitfalls and bring industry standards and best practices to the team Requirements (Minimum Qualifications) A degree or professional qualification in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience Good Knowledge of data science and machine learning concepts and tools, such as Python, R, or SQL. Good understanding of data modelling, data architecture, and data quality principles. Experience with agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban. Competent in programming languages such as Scala, Python, Java Competent in using DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines effectively Nice to Have Good technical skills in areas such as data warehousing, ETL, data governance, and data visualization. Experience with cluster management and DevOps tools (e.g. Ansible, Kubernetes) Experience working in an agile and innovative environment Experience in distributed systems Experience with cloud-based analytics platforms, such as AWS or Azure. Experience with Tableau Server, including design, implementation, and maintenance. Why join us? The work is purposeful and meaningful You will work with the best engineers We work with modern technologies and tech stacks We have excellent engineering culture and work-life balance We aspire to engineering and operational excellence We empower to innovate We grow together as a family As CSIT is an agency under the Ministry of Defence (Singapore), only Singapore Citizens will be considered.
jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Data Exploration Platform Management

jobs.description_text: As a Software Engineer, you will join a multidisciplinary product development team that plays a crucial role in enabling data discovery and facilitating data-driven decision-marking. Your team will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing technical data solutions to streamline data search and discovery, enable seamless exploration and utilization of data assets, and support data sensemaking for decision-making. In this role, you will need a strong foundation in software engineering and contribute across the full technology stack, from building data processing pipelines to developing backend data services and front-end interfaces. Your role will also involve adopting state-of-the-art technologies, including AI components, as part of the technical solution. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain high-quality applications and/or data pipelines Source, evaluate, and integrate state-of-the-art technologies into applications and/or data pipelines Debug and resolve bugs and performance issues Participate in code and design reviews to enhance code quality and software architecture Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies related to software and data engineering Communicate technical solutions effectively to diverse stakeholders Minimum Requirements A degree or professional qualification in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field 2 years of experience in application development Strong proficiency in Python, Java, and JavaScript programming languages Familiarity with ReactJS/TypeScript and Spring Boot Experience with microservice architecture, and REST API design and integration Familiarity with relational (e.g. MSSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g. MongoDB), and search engines (e.g. Elasticsearch) Familiarity with Git and Agile development methodologies Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills Nice to Have Experience with cloud-native infrastructure (such as Docker, Kubernetes container infrastructure) Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines Experience with using Generative AI technologies and frameworks such as LangChain Experience with using Tableau As CSIT is an agency under the Ministry of Defence (Singapore), only Singapore Citizens will be considered.
jobs.title: Software Engineer (Data Discovery and Operations)

jobs.description_text: We are a team that designs, develops, and implements technical solutions to facilitate key analytical workflows in information analysis and sensemaking for MINDEF analysts. As a full stack AI Software Engineers/Senior Software Engineer, you will lead and/or contribute to the development and integration of AI services into a single Workspace product for users who are guided by the research analytical process, facilitating collaboration, sensemaking, and knowledge management. Your role will be important in developing AI-powered products to enable MINDEF analysts to deliver timely and relevant insights to consumers. Responsibilities Design, develop, and run the internal information analysis product that supports real-time collaborative and AI-assisted sensemaking features. Ensure enterprise system performance, reliability, and sustainability by building optimised and scalable cloud-native web applications and services that are designed for high concurrency and low latency workloads. Work with product managers, staff software engineers, designers and key stakeholders to deliver impactful tech solutions that meet critical operational user needs. Stay updated with latest tech industry trends and software engineering technologies, and conducting tech exploration to determine implementation feasibility where relevant. Requirements (Minimum Qualifications) A degree or professional qualification in Computer Science or a related field. Applicants for the Senior Software Engineer role should possess proven practical experience in software development. Experience with frontend - React.js, TypeScript Proficient in backend - Java with Spring Boot or Python with FastAPI Solid understanding of microservices architecture and RESTful APIs design Experience working with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Gitlab CI) Self-driven and able to work independently Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Collaborative mindset with a willingness to learn and share knowledge Nice to Have Interest or experience in building AI-powered enterprise applications (e.g. LLMs, agents orchestration, MCP servers, etc.) Experience with containers deployment and orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) Familiarity with: Relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL) NoSQL databases (e.g. MongoDB) Search engine or vector databases (e.g. Elasticsearch) Object stores (e.g. Minio) As CSIT is an agency under the Ministry of Defence (Singapore), only Singapore Citizens will be considered.

jobs.description_text: Collaboration is the backbone of how our organization works. As a Staff Collaboration Platform Engineer, you will be at the forefront of designing, evolving, and maintaining the core collaboration systems that enable thousands of employees to connect, co-create, and deliver. In this role, you will not only ensure reliability and scale, but you will architect, innovate and influence the platform's direction. You will mentor engineers, drive proof-of-concepts, lead integrations, and own strategic collaboration domains across the enterprise. If you are passionate about shaping the future of workplace collaboration, we would love to hear from you. Responsibilities Lead the design and development of enterprise collaboration platforms, including chat, conferencing, file share, and email, driving technical roadmaps and domain-level responsibilities. Drive platform resilience, performance, and reliability through advanced automation, proactive issue detection, and remediation. Implement AI-powered solutions and integrate communication tools and core business workflows to streamline collaboration. Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers, providing technical reviews, architectural guidance, and oversight to ensure engineering excellence across the team Evaluate and optimize collaboration systems, making trade-offs between custom and off-the-shelf systems, and driving continuous optimization, performance tuning and tech debt-reduction. Requirements (Minimum Qualifications) A degree or professional qualification in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience, with 4+ years of experience in platform/systems/infrastructure roles. Deep expertise in at least one collaboration/communication domain (e.g. conferencing, chat/messaging, bots/integration frameworks) and proficiency in programming/scripting languages (e.g. Python, Powershell) Strong experience with automation, Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and system observability/monitoring. Experience with scalable architectures, containerization and identify/access management (e.g. SSO, RBAC) Proven leadership qualities, including strong problem-solving skills, and ability to provide technical guidance using system-level thinking. Nice to Have Experience integrating AI/automation agents into enterprise systems or developing real-time collaboration stacks (e.g. video streaming) Prior work on performance engineering, latency optimization, high throughput systems. Experience with COTS (commercial) solutions with custom-built modules, or open-source technologies. Experience working in regulated or high-security environments. What you will gain Autonomy to experiment with new frameworks, AI, or next-gen collaboration tools. Path toward Principal Engineer, Domain Lead, or Architect roles. Training, certification support, and access to conferences. Cross-functional exposure (e.g. cybersecurity, UX, cloud infrastructure) to broaden your skillset. As CSIT is an agency under the Ministry of Defence (Singapore), only Singapore Citizens will be considered.
jobs.title: Staff Collaboration Platform Engineer

You will be responsible for designing and developing them in a performant, reliable and maintainable manner while leveraging pragmatic unit, integration and performance testing. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of Finastra-based banking transformation initiatives for a fast-growing fintech organization building next-generation AI-powered banking solutions. In this role, you will oversee the implementation, integration, and enhancement of Finastra core banking platforms while working closely with product, engineering, AI, and business stakeholders. You will play a key role in delivering complex banking projects that leverage Artificial Intelligence to modernize banking operations, automate workflows, and enhance customer experiences across the full banking software suite. The ideal candidate has strong experience managing Finastra implementation projects, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a proven track record of delivering enterprise banking technology programs. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES · Lead end-to-end delivery of Finastra implementation and transformation projects, ensuring delivery within scope, budget, and timelines. · Manage project planning, governance, risk management, resource allocation, and project reporting. · Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into actionable project plans. · Coordinate cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, AI, QA, Infrastructure, and third-party vendors. · Oversee integration of Finastra platforms with internal applications, third-party systems, and AI-powered banking solutions. · Drive project execution across the software development lifecycle using Agile, Scrum, or hybrid methodologies. · Manage project dependencies, risks, issues, and change requests while ensuring successful delivery. · Facilitate workshops, steering committee meetings, and executive stakeholder updates. · Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards, regulatory requirements, and business objectives. · Support user acceptance testing (UAT), deployment planning, production rollout, and post-implementation activities. · Work closely with AI and Data teams to enable intelligent automation, AI-driven workflows, and advanced analytics across banking platforms. · Drive continuous improvement initiatives and establish project management best practices. REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline. · 8+ years of project management experience delivering enterprise banking or financial services technology projects. · Proven experience managing Finastra implementation, migration, upgrade, or integration projects. · Strong understanding of core banking systems and banking operations, including deposits, lending, payments, customer onboarding, and digital banking. · Experience managing complex enterprise software implementations involving multiple stakeholders and vendors. · Strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies. · Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills. · Experience managing project budgets, schedules, resource planning, and vendor relationships. · Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS · Experience with one or more Finastra solutions such as Fusion Essence, Fusion Phoenix, Fusion Equation, Fusion Loan IQ, Fusion Trade Innovation, or Fusion Digital Banking. · Experience working with AI-powered banking platforms, intelligent automation, or digital transformation initiatives. · Knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud technologies, and enterprise integration architectures. · PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum Master, or equivalent project management certification. · Experience within fintech, digital banking, or financial institutions is highly desirable.
jobs.title: Project Manager – Finastra Core Banking & AI Transformation

Focus - Build end-to-end product features across frontend, backend, and AI integrations - Design agent workflows that handle planning, tool use, failure, and recovery across multiple steps. - Integrate LLMs, memory, and external tools into systems that behave reliably under real-world conditions - Design real-time AI interactions with streaming, partial results, and tight latency constraints - Improve system reliability, observability, and fallback mechanisms - Collaborate closely with ML, backend, and product teams to ship features end-to-end - Continuously iterate based on real usage and failure modes Ideal Experiences - Strong experience in full stack engineering (frontend + backend) - Solid understanding of system design and API architecture - Experience working with LLMs, RAG systems, or AI-powered applications - Ability to handle ambiguity and make pragmatic engineering decisions - Strong ownership - able to take features from idea to production - Comfort working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements Outcomes - Own and ship AI-native product features that move beyond chat into persistent, goal-driven workflows - Design and deploy agent workflows that reliably complete multi-step tasks across tools and sessions - Reduce latency and improve responsiveness of AI interactions while maintaining output quality - Build robust fallback and recovery mechanisms for LLM and tool failures in production environments - Improve the success rate and reliability of AI-driven workflows through iteration, evaluation, and monitoring - Establish patterns and abstractions for integrating LLMs, memory, and external tools into scalable product systems - Contribute to a product experience where AI feels proactive, consistent, and dependable over time Tech Stack - Next.js - Python - NodeJs - Pytorch - OpenAI / Anthropic / open-source LLMs - SQl & noSQL - Kubernetes - Docker

jobs.description_text: Role: Product Engineer – Cybersecurity Architect – Product & Innovation Location: Singapore CYBERSECURITY ARCHITECT – PRODUCT & INNOVATION ROLE OVERVIEW We are partnering with a leading technology-driven telecommunications organisation that is expanding its cybersecurity capabilities to support new digital initiatives, innovation projects and critical infrastructure. We are looking for a product-focused Cybersecurity Architect with 5–10 years of cybersecurity/IT experience to design, assess and deliver secure architectures for innovation projects and critical infrastructure environments. The role will work closely with Cybersecurity, Network, Cloud, Infrastructure, Application and Technology teams to embed Security-by-Design, Zero Trust and resilient security principles into new products, platforms and digital solutions. The ideal candidate should combine strong security architecture and engineering expertise with the ability to translate business and security requirements into practical, scalable and production-ready cybersecurity solutions. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES CYBERSECURITY SOLUTION ARCHITECTURE - Design and review cybersecurity architectures for enterprise, telecom and critical infrastructure environments. - Conduct security architecture reviews, threat modelling, risk assessments and security gap analysis. - Define security requirements for new platforms, applications, APIs, cloud and infrastructure projects. - Design security solutions covering IAM, PAM, Zero Trust, network security, API security, cloud security and infrastructure security. - Define security architecture and requirements for multi-cloud infrastructure, covering the full plan-build-operate lifecycle. - Design and assess solutions for encryption, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, secrets management and cryptographic services. - Evaluate cybersecurity technologies, solutions and vendors, and support RFP/RFQ, POC and technical evaluation activities. - Assess security requirements for AI/ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI platforms, including solutions operating in air-gapped environments. - Develop High-Level Designs (HLDs), security architecture documents, security control matrices, reference architectures and technical recommendations. - Partner with engineering and operations teams to ensure security controls are implemented effectively and aligned with architectural requirements. CYBERSECURITY PRODUCT ENGINEERING - Design, develop and deliver cybersecurity products, MVPs and production-ready security solutions aligned with business and security objectives. - Translate business, product and security requirements into scalable, secure and resilient technical solutions. - Evaluate emerging cybersecurity technologies, platforms and products for enterprise adoption. - Build reusable security frameworks, reference architectures, implementation blueprints and engineering assets. - Drive Security-by-Design principles across enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms and digital services. - Work closely with product and engineering teams to convert security concepts and prototypes into deployable solutions. - Support the productization, implementation and adoption of cybersecurity capabilities across the organization. - Identify opportunities to improve security architecture, engineering practices and technology capabilities through emerging cybersecurity innovations. REQUIRED SKILLS SECURITY ARCHITECTURE & ENGINEERING - Strong expertise in Cybersecurity Architecture, Security Engineering and Threat Modelling. - Experience designing and implementing security controls across enterprise environments. - Strong understanding of Network & Infrastructure Security. - Experience with Cloud and Kubernetes Security. - Strong knowledge of API Security. - Experience with IAM, PAM and Zero Trust architectures. - Strong understanding of PKI, HSM, KMS, encryption and cryptography. - Knowledge of vulnerability management, risk management and security controls. - Experience with security product evaluation, vendor assessment and technical due diligence. SECURITY PLATFORMS & TECHNOLOGIES Familiarity with security platforms and technologies such as: - SIEM - XDR / EDR - CNAPP - WAF - API Security - Cloud security platforms - Identity and privileged access management platforms - Secrets and certificate management solutions EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS - 5–10 years of overall cybersecurity/IT experience, including at least 3+ years in cybersecurity architecture or security engineering. - Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale security architecture and technology transformation initiatives. - Experience working across cloud, infrastructure, network, application and cybersecurity domains. - Experience in telecommunications, critical infrastructure or large-scale technology environments is preferred. - Demonstrated ability to work with cross-functional engineering and technology teams and influence security-by-design decisions. - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills. - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline. - CISSP, CCSP, CISM or equivalent cybersecurity certifications are preferred.
jobs.title: Product Engineer – Cybersecurity Architect – Product & Innovation
